text.tspan: Routes /staff/admin/doctors and /staff/admin/doctors/:id. The doctor list and each doctor’s profile and weekly chambers.

g.text: Lumina Specialized Hospital · UI wireframes v0.1 · October 2026

text.tspan: Changing chamber times does not move existing bookings.
“Add doctor” opens the same form as Edit, empty.
Every doctor with specialty, weekly chambers, fee
and status. Hidden doctors stay in the system but
patients cannot see or book them.
Profile in English and Bangla. The fee is shown to
patients and paid at the counter.
Weekly chambers: day, start and end, minutes per
patient, patient limit and room. The number of slots
is worked out and shown. Changes apply to new
